source_caption:
🎬 And So It Goes (2014)

And So It Goes follows Oren Little, a wealthy but bitter real estate agent whose unpleasant personality and selfish attitude have pushed nearly everyone out of his life. Living alone in a small waterfront apartment complex, Oren spends his days avoiding meaningful relationships, arguing with neighbors, and focusing on selling his luxurious family home so he can retire comfortably. His carefully controlled life takes an unexpected turn when his estranged son suddenly appears and asks him to care for Sarah, a young granddaughter Oren never knew existed. Completely unprepared for the responsibilities of raising a child, Oren reluctantly turns to his compassionate neighbor Leah, a widowed lounge singer who sees beyond his difficult personality. As Leah helps care for Sarah, her warmth, patience, and kindness gradually begin challenging Oren’s cynical outlook on life. Despite their frequent disagreements and contrasting personalities, the two develop an unexpected connection that forces them to confront their emotional struggles and painful memories. Meanwhile, Sarah’s presence brings new energy into their lives, creating opportunities for laughter, family bonding, and personal growth. Through awkward encounters, humorous misunderstandings, romantic moments, and heartfelt conversations, Oren slowly discovers that happiness cannot be measured by wealth or personal success. Combining gentle comedy, emotional storytelling, memorable performances, and an uplifting message, the film explores love, family, forgiveness, second chances, companionship, and the importance of opening your heart to unexpected relationships.

🎭 Genre: Romantic Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 5.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 34m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Rob Reiner

source_details.synopsis: And So It Goes is a 2014 American comedy drama film directed by Rob Reiner and written by Mark Andrus. The film stars Michael Douglas, Diane Keaton and Sterling Jerins. Self-absorbed realtor Oren enlists the help of his neighbor Leah when he is suddenly left in charge of Sarah, the granddaughter he suddenly meets, when his estranged son Luke drops her off at his home. In the process, the pair is able to heal emotionally. The film was released on July 25, 2014, received mostly negative reviews from critics, and performed modestly at the box office.
